decision.reason: the committed AIP authority provides a tenant-scoped one-time Handoff transport service, but no canonical HTTP/OpenAPI/SDK surface or durable accept, reject, request-more and return decision authority exists; W3-01 and W3-05 are not runtime GREEN

authorityRefresh.hardBoundary: No Agent is runnable and no real CapabilityBinding exists

transportProperties: org and project scoped PostgreSQL authority
exact active sender and receiver AgentInstance revisions
one-time bearer token stored only as a hash
minimal object, artifact and evidence refs with allowlist and markings
issue idempotency and revoke version CAS
committedAipFacts.terminalConsume: consume changes issued to consumed and the same envelope cannot be consumed or reopened again
committedAipFacts.missingRuntimeSurface: no canonical Handoff HTTP routes, OpenAPI operations or frontend SDK were found in the committed baseline
committedAipFacts.missingDomainAuthority: no durable accept, reject, request_more or returned decision aggregate and no canonical list or decision timeline surface were found

ownershipDecision.aipTransportAuthority: HandoffEnvelope owns issued, consumed, revoked and expired transport lifecycle only
ownershipDecision.workshopCompiler: one ModuleHandoffCompiler compiles source Module, Case or Batch item, requestedOutcome, purpose, deadline, allowed fields, markings, target Module and ResponsibilitySlot into canonical TaskRun refs and HandoffEnvelope input
ownershipDecision.domainDecisionAuthority: a separate immutable HandoffDecisionRevision owns accepted, rejected, request_more and returned outcomes after successful consume
ownershipDecision.requestMoreRule: request_more records only typed missing-context or missing-evidence codes; the source issues a new HandoffEnvelope with a new token and explicit correlation or supersedes ref after reauthorization
ownershipDecision.rejectRule: reject does not cancel the source Task or TaskRun and does not change transport history
ownershipDecision.acceptRule: accepted means the receiver accepted the scoped context, not that downstream work started or completed
ownershipDecision.returnRule: results return as exact ReturnReceipt, Observation or EffectReview refs and never write the source Module domain table

targetCommands.result: issued HandoffEnvelope plus one-time token and Receipt
targetCommands.forbidden: client-side payload assembly or token persistence

targetCommands.result: append-only accepted, rejected, request_more or returned decision Receipt
targetCommands.forbidden: reopening or mutating a consumed HandoffEnvelope

requiredGreenEvidence: canonical tenant-scoped issue, get, consume, revoke and timeline API plus OpenAPI and strict SDK
server-side permission and receiver reauthorization for every transport and decision command
one ModuleHandoffCompiler with manifest, ResponsibilitySlot, exact-ref, allowlist and marking validation
append-only HandoffDecisionRevision with idempotency, expected version and typed reason codes
request-more creates a new correlated envelope and never reopens the consumed envelope
expiry, replay, wrong receiver, revoked instance, cross-tenant ref and over-disclosure failures
org-org positive flow and dev-org isolation without synthetic authority
refresh reconstruction and transport plus decision quantity conservation
W3-01 and W3-05 runtime GREEN before W3-06 implementation

tests.reason: this preflight inspected committed contracts, service behavior, tests and Workshop plans only; runtime implementation remains blocked
doesNotProve: a canonical Handoff API or SDK
accept, reject, request-more or return persistence

next: remediate the Workshop Handoff plan so transport lifecycle and domain decision lifecycle are explicit, then re-review without marking W3-06 complete
safety: read-only committed source, test, OpenAPI, authority and plan inspection
no source, database, tenant, AgentRun, Handoff, Action or external mutation
w1-aip uncommitted content was not read or modified
